page.title: Mandates
page.purpose: Show what authority currently exists, when each grant lapses, and what recurs. An operator uses this page to answer what an agent is allowed to do right now.

priorities.statement: A live mandate is distinguishable from an expired, exhausted, or revoked one
Time remaining before expiry is stated, not left to be computed from a date
Standing mandates show their next charge date and cancel in one action
The scope of each grant is readable without opening it
Revocation is available and clearly irreversible

states.description: Mandates exist across several lifecycle states.
No mandate has been issued; the page explains what a mandate grants.
A revocation or cancellation is being recorded.
A mandate was issued or revoked; the change is confirmed in terms of what it now permits.
A proposed mandate exceeds the budget backing it; the page names the constraint.
Some data resolved and some did not; the page names which rather than showing a blank.
Displayed data is older than its refresh interval and states its age.

claims.statement: Live, expired, exhausted and revoked mandates are mutually distinguishable by text or shape, not colour alone.
Time remaining is stated in relative terms alongside the absolute expiry.
A standing mandate is cancellable from its row without navigating into a detail view.
The revoke control states that revocation is terminal and that reissue is the alternative.
Revoke and cancel are keyboard-operable with a visible focus state.
